commits.notes: Frozen repository-owned synthetic reference workflow, domain invariants, fixtures, and self-contained validator.
Reverified exact archive digests against downloaded upstream releases.
Reverified the Go engine and supervisor, including occupied ports, child exit and startup cancellation.
Version 1 manifest validation verified through the Go engine and browser with typed error, request limit and restart coverage.

Recoverable local authoritative writes port implemented and verified with single writer exclusivity, bounded state, atomic visible manifest, idempotency, auth precedence, path containment, streaming recovery, interrupted/disk-full recovery and negative cases.

Clean-checkout Go engine build, fail-closed CI test collection (.github/workflows/runtime.yml), test discovery documentation (docs/engineering/ENGINE_TESTS.md), and C06 security/integrity integration tests verified.
Analyst case and evidence aggregates (internal/cases/model.go) enforce single-case evidence ownership, explicit cross-case access rejection, prerequisite checks, and restart recovery.

Bounded streaming evidence upload into isolated quarantine with SHA-256 hashing, path/symlink rejection, interrupt/retry safety, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/upload.go and tests/upload_test.go.

Durable content-addressed blob commit before atomic evidence manifest sealing, hash-mismatch abort, boundary-crash orphan recovery, lost-ACK idempotency, bounded retries, quota checks, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/seal.go and tests/seal_test.go.

Read-only sealed byte and manifest integrity verification with distinct failure classification (1-byte digest_mismatch vs size_mismatch vs missing_file), Ed25519 signer trust/expiry enforcement, monotonic anti-rollback AuthorityTracker, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/verify.go and tests/integrity_test.go.

Append-only attributable custody ledger with mandatory actor/timestamp/reason records, SHA-256 cryptographic hash chaining, anti-rewrite invariants, restart durability, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/custody/events.go and tests/custody_test.go.

Independent verification of signed externally stored custody roots, outside signer trust allowlisting, Ed25519 signature validation, anti-rollback CheckpointTracker, FileCheckpointStore adapter, and ledger rewrite detection verified in internal/custody/checkpoints.go and tests/checkpoint_test.go.

Legal hold blocking of deletion and retention expiration under concurrency, durable attribution and reason auditing, restart recovery, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/holds/service.go and tests/hold_test.go.

Fixed non-executing CSV and JSON analyzer interface, shipped allowlist enforcement, sealed evidence read-only verification, and deterministic config/tool provenance verified in internal/analyzers/provider.go and tests/analyzer_contract_test.go.

Bounded analyzer sandbox isolation, private 0700 scratch allocation with quota tracking, outbound network interception (ErrNetworkForbidden), execution deadline aborts, and read-only sealed evidence byte verification verified in internal/analyzers/sandbox.go and tests/isolation_test.go.

Derived artifact manifests bound to sealed input hashes, allowlisted tool version, deterministic config hash, and optional Ed25519 attestation with atomic staging, restart recovery, and read-only source verification in internal/artifacts/manifest.go and tests/provenance_test.go.

Timestamp normalization preserving raw_timestamp and confidence while leaving unknown zones, RFC3339 -00:00, DST fall-back ambiguity (candidate_utcs), and DST spring-forward gaps explicit rather than fabricating UTC, plus atomic TimeStore import/restart recovery in internal/timeline/time.go and tests/time_test.go.

Stable derived EventIdentity calculation (canonical JSON + SHA-256 excluding volatile run/slice order), deduplicating EventIndexStore with C16/C17/SealStore integration, deterministic sorting, atomic persistence, and restart recovery in internal/timeline/index.go and tests/timeline_test.go.

Bounded local timeline index search (MaxResults, MaxScanEvents, ExpandDepth, MaxExpandDegree, MaxVisitedNodes, cycle detection, context deadline/cancellation) and deterministic atomic RebuildCaseIndex from verified C16 derived artifacts and immutable SealStore inputs in internal/timeline/search.go and tests/search_test.go.

Epistemic separation of analyst hypotheses (requiring non-empty Author and Rationale, IsSourceEvidence=false, RecordKind=analyst_hypothesis) from cryptographically bound ObservedFacts (backed by SealStore and EventIndexStore) in internal/findings/notes.go and tests/facts_test.go; rejects UI-label/flag promotion and persisted tampering across restarts.
